reviews.text: I found them very professional and friendly! I recommend them!

A few months ago I took my roseicollis bird to be dewormed. Unfortunately, I didn't know that Dr. Daniel no longer worked at that clinic, and I was attended to by a young man with no experience who almost killed my bird by giving it an excessive dose. After a few hours, it was as if dead, unable to move. I was terrified of my life; I really thought it was going to die. It was hospitalized for a day and given IV fluids; it was a miracle that it survived thanks to the good professional I found at a good clinic. If you love your animals, I don't recommend this clinic to anyone.

With a stressed cat, for the first time, thanks to the patience, dedication, and care of Dr. Cátia, we were able to feel that my pet had a proper consultation. The space was well-maintained, and everything else was excellent, which made us feel very good. A big thank you to the clinic and to Dr. Cátia.
Can highly recommend!
Excellent service! The veterinarian Cátia is very friendly and professional. Our dog is always very well treated ☺️

I can only say good things about this clinic and the people who work there!
About a year ago, my rabbit had a dental problem that prevented her from eating and at the same time she was going into digestive arrest. She was hospitalized until she was more recovered, so that she could have dental treatment. When I brought her home, I was told how to give her medication and the team was very helpful with any clarifications.
Almost a year later, I detected a mammary nodule, I took her back to Vetolaias, she was examined and it was decided to perform surgery to remove the mammary gland. The plan this time was to sterilize her to control possible future problems. I waited about a month (due to the general anesthesia) and when the pre-operative abdominal ultrasound was scheduled to assess possible metastases, Bia already had a new problem where blood was coming out every time she urinated. When she had the ultrasound, it was found to be pyometra or uterine carcinoma.

The machine needed for the surgeries was broken and there was no estimate of when they could operate on my little one, so once again I only have good things to say about this team, in this case more specifically about Dr. Daniel. Immediately after the ultrasound, he contacted a partner clinic that gave the green light for me to go directly there with my little one, to be operated on the next day. She was operated on 3 days ago and looking at her behavior you would never say that she had surgery, as she is perfectly normal eating and using the toilet.
I am very grateful for the professionalism and humanity of these people!
I recommend them. I always go with my rabbit. Excellent professionalism.

I became a fan, very professional doctors, 5-star service, very affordable prices.
The clinic is super clean.
I loved it.
Excellent

We have so much to thank the entire team for, without exception.
They are very available, professional, attentive, and you can see the affection they have for the animals that come into their hands in the way they work.
My chinchillas receive the best care from them!
We highly recommend them if you want a trustworthy place to take your pet! :)

The staff were super friendly and attentive to the animals.
I recommend them.

I am extremely grateful to the VetOlaias clinic for the way my animals were treated: a super professional and empathetic team. Dr. Daniel was tireless in his care of my baby turtles; we felt truly supported and confident that we couldn't have found better hands. The clinic's prices are very reasonable, and their entire approach is not at all abusive (they don't impose unnecessary/expensive treatments). I highly recommend VetOlaias to anyone looking for an attentive and professional veterinarian who is equally reliable in their pricing.

I always receive excellent service! They pay close attention to our animals and are very available. The prices are quite reasonable for the service they provide. I go there with my exotic animals and I recommend them to everyone!!
Wonderful professionals. They saved my cat's life! Thank you!

I am so grateful for this office and the kind staff. Daniel was incredible and helped me with two issues my dog was having, along with paperwork I need for traveling and staying in Portugal. Every staff member was so kind and welcoming, and very loving to my dog. The care felt so genuine.
The entire team was friendly, professional, and dedicated. Their approach was practical and straightforward. I highly recommend them!
Very friendly and competent veterinarians. I recommend them to anyone who needs their services and lives nearby!
A benchmark. In the care, attention, and professionalism shown to all those whose needs lead them to VetOlaias. My thanks.
Thank you for your compassion.
Very professional and caring veterinarians.
Always friendly and helpful.
Attentive people. Good experience 👍🏻 …
Super friendly and attentive service with the animals.

I visited Vet Olaias to get my Pet Passport. They accommodated me with a same-day appointment and issued the passport in less than an hour. Excellent service and very cost-effective. Highly recommend!

I am immensely grateful to the veterinarian for processing my dog's passport in less than an hour! Now he's ready for more adventures thanks to you!

I really enjoyed it, it was easy to book the appointment, we were seen immediately at the scheduled time, I found both the doctor and the receptionist friendly and efficient. I registered my bird for free, the consultation was less than 30 minutes (it was the first consultation) and I was also surprised at how cheap it was! A consultation is at least €30 and even leaving with 3 medications and a vaccine, the total was €46, which is surprising for exotic animals. In short, I will return :)
The veterinarians are super kind and attentive; my Paco is treated very well there.
